mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 4% for 3 consecutive months reduces the present value of future equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.25 percentage point rise in the federal funds rate within a 3-month window increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2% for 3 consecutive months signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 20,000 jobs for 3 consecutive months reduces labor market tightness, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decrease in employment (PAYEMS) below -10,000 jobs for 3 consecutive months indicates labor market slack, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in slack periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 2% for 3 consecutive months signals robust demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) below -2% for 3 consecutive months indicates supply-side weakness, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in weakness periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below -2% for 3 consecutive months combined with a monthly increase in CPIAUCSL above 0.2% for 3 consecutive months indicates supply-side weakness amplified by inflation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases by >2% over 3 months AND CPIAUCSL increases by >0.2% over 3 months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in shock periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
